final.role: Library for parsing, modifying and writing YAML (frontmatter/config), preserving comments and blank lines.
final.evidence: 'definitive library for YAML'; 'runs on Node.js as well as modern browsers'; 'Supports parsing, modifying, and writing YAML comments'; ISC license.

auditoria.nota: Dependency-free JS YAML parser that round-trips comments; a good fit for agent tools that edit note frontmatter without destroying it.
